explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to parse the body fragment with browser-like table structure, then walked tokens with next_tag(), next_token(), get_current_depth(), get_token_type(), get_tag(), is_tag_closer(), and get_modifiable_text(). The function records rows and cells on TR/TD/TH openers and closers, accumulating only ordinary text node content inside each cell.
